what: The squad that the climb against the gang clones ranks first, as arguments of scripts/pk-squad.ts
status: winner of the bench climb; not run live
evidence: research/gang-clones.md "The climb": hosted bench runs 44258391927 (seeds 1, 2, 3, 40 conditions) and 44259940425 (seeds 4, 5, 6): five of ours kill 90 of 90 gang clones over six seeds and five clone modes with no death of ours

members.note: Four of ours kill 89 of 90. Five end a run in fewer ticks than four on 5 of 6 seeds (480 against 516). A squad with no bow kills 4 of 9: each member needs a strung bow, or at most two members have none (9 of 9 at 36 Hitpoints a kill).

options: the default SQUAD_OPTS of scripts/pk-squad.ts: no change of one option beat it by more than the spread of the base (29 to 104 Hitpoints a run across six seeds)

post.reason: the gang's own single-way post: 7 of 9 kills at 95 Hitpoints a kill, against 9 of 9 at 20 on the same seeds

a style rule for each gang account and a kill order (one option set and the lowest health bar in scripts/pk-squad.ts)
